title: The credits pill on Today's AI card tells screen readers it opens AI credits, but it opens the assistant
what: On the Today screen the small credits pill on the AI Assistant card is read out as '{n} AI credits. Open AI credits.' A tap opens the AI Assistant itself (the same as tapping the ask box), not the credits sheet. The same pill inside the assistant does open the credits sheet.
expected: The pill on Today opens the AI credits sheet, or its spoken label says it opens the AI Assistant.
fix_line: Make the Today pill open the credits sheet, or give it its own label

title: An idea tapped on Today is dropped with no word when the assistant is busy or today's questions are used up
what: Tapping an idea's action button on the Today card hands its sentence to the assistant to be asked at once. If an earlier request is still thinking (the side panel on a computer), or today's question limit is reached, the sentence is taken and thrown away: it is not asked and not put in the box. The owner sees the assistant open and nothing happen. The same idea rows inside the assistant are greyed out while a request is running; the ones on Today are not.
expected: The sentence is kept in the ask box (or asked when the running request ends), and the owner is told why it was not asked.
fix_line: When a handed-over sentence cannot be asked, put it in the box instead of dropping it
